notes: Found by job-scout; Berlin remote-first; recruiter posting, ask for client name and salary band; English accepted
apply_hint: Apply via the LinkedIn posting (https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4475036239); it goes to Michael Page. On the first recruiter call ask: client name, team size, salary band, how remote-first works (office days in Berlin?), and whether the role is classic ML or GenAI-heavy.
verdict: Solid match on the stated profile (degree, applied ML and deep learning, Python with TensorFlow/PyTorch, databases and data analysis, cloud, agile). The posting is generic and the employer is not named, so fit can't be checked against a real product; your strongest work (GenAI, agents, evaluation) is broader than what they list.

form_fields.label: Why this company?
form_fields.value: You bring AI into existing business processes for customers across industries; that is what I did at Kniit and Covestro, owning systems end to end.

form_fields.label: Salary expectation
form_fields.value: €70,000 gross/year (range €60,000–75,000). Must be above the EU Blue Card threshold.

form_fields.label: Location
form_fields.value: Berlin / remote within Germany; willing to relocate and travel.

questions.q: Tell us about an ML or deep learning model you built and how you validated it.
questions.a: Covestro intern: Random Forest, XGBoost, LSTM on sensor time series; lag + rolling-window features; benchmarked against empirical curve-fitting; Streamlit dashboard for chemists. Cognizant: LSTM at 96% test accuracy vs ARIMA/SARIMA/Prophet/XGBoost.

questions.q: How did you improve an algorithm's performance and accuracy?
questions.a: Kniit: multi-agent LangGraph pipeline validated against SAP-derived ground truth, precision/recall 33/45 → 93/90. Second stream: deterministic code instead of an LLM, $200k projected budget → near zero, accuracy toward 100%.

questions.q: How do you integrate AI into an existing system landscape?
questions.a: MCP query service into Claude Code; Expert Interface on Azure (React + Python microservices); Covestro FastAPI backend, Docker, AWS CDK, GitLab CI/CD.
